description: Add LRU eviction (bounded capacity) plus per-entry TTL expiry to an unbounded cache
prompts: cache.ts's Cache is an unbounded Map wrapper - get/put never evict anything. Turn it into an LRU cache with a TTL: the constructor takes (capacity: number, ttl: number) - a max size and a time-to-live in seconds. put(key: string, value: number, now: number): void stores a value timestamped at `now`. get(key: string, now: number): number | undefined returns the value if present AND not expired (now - storedAt < ttl), else undefined - and an expired entry must be REMOVED the moment it's observed to be stale. Both get and put must refresh a key's recency. When put() would exceed `capacity`, evict the LEAST recently used entry (recency = most recent get OR put) before inserting the new one. The file must compile under tsc --strict.
name: add_ts_lru_cache_with_ttl

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit cache.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build cache.ts
node behavior_test.js
